pyramiding_rule: Prohibit stacking duplicate tickets within 2.00 price handles of an active position; require a minimum 3-ATR impulse confirmation before scaling in.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) confirmation > 65% and zero high-impact macroeconomic news releases within a +/- 15-minute window before order submission.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops once floating profit hits +$4.00 to lock in gains and eliminate evaporation risk.
